I'm still a bit unclear on why this is necessary. We re-level the API call rate when we add a new instance:

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/03b7b1305c09887fc50404382d1408255c77917b/homeassistant/components/airvisual/__init__.py#L246-L248

...or remove an instance:

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/03b7b1305c09887fc50404382d1408255c77917b/homeassistant/components/airvisual/__init__.py#L352-L354

If we haven't added or removed an instance, why would we need to consider re-leveling with every API call?

In fact, when HA restarts, it reloads all instance in an asynchrenous way. This triggers the issue.
In order the see the problem here after a scenario : 
- Imagine 2 cities, let's say A and B.
- At first time, no city are declared
- then user declare one city A ==> Airvisual create the instance , no other city exist (interval between 2 requests is then not re-evaluated)
- then user declare the other city B ==> Airvisual create the instance , see that an other instance exists, and updates the interval between 2 requests [The interval function sees only A and not A+B ==> this is false]
- a trigger force HA to be restarted (at a software update for instance)
- both A & B are already declared in HA
- HA restart at the same time the instance A & B
- at same time (i.e. in parallel), the instance A & B are taken into account by Airvisual
- A & B perform the same action at same time
- At this moment Airvisual has not stored A & B, and so when A or B asks if there is another instance, the gloval variable is empty
- so no need to re-evaluate the interval between 2 requests
- Then A&B instanciation are started

==> in this scenario A&B are still with the default value 5minutes wheras is shall be higher

That's why I put a re-evaluation on instanciation update.
Perhaps, the interval computation can be added AFTER storage of Airvisual instance

Great it works by moving the time of interval computing during the instanciation.
I will look for the remove (I think there is an error)

The pull was performed without pylint issue, this time.
I think the last pull shows why there is (was ;-) ) an issue at startup

issue_context.title: airvisual assessment of interval between 2 requests : missing trigger
issue_context.body:
### The problem

The ability to re-evaluate the interval between 2 requests (for airvisual) is performed upon the addition of one town.
If you suppress, one town or reboot HA, the ability is not performed.

Indeed the function async_get_cloud_api_update_interval is not called (the trace "[homeassistant.components.airvisual] Leveling API key usage" is not called

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2021.3.4

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Core

### Integration causing the issue

airvisual

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/airvisual/

### Example YAML snippet

```yaml
# Put your YAML below this line

```


### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

```txt
# Put your logs below this line
From home-assistant.log (when it's ok)
2021-03-22 08:38:27 DEBUG (MainThread) [homeassistant.components.airvisual] Leveling API key usage (xxxxxxxxxxxx): 5 consumers, 27 minutes between updates

Issue :
this trace does not occurs on reboot or upon removing an integration via UI

```


In airvisual package, the function `def async_get_cloud_api_update_interval(hass, api_key, num_consumers):` is called on adding a new point.

Hey there @bachya, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with an integration (`airvisual`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L31) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>
I m the code owner of worldtidesinfocustom. An integration for HA
I apologize, but I am unclear what issue is being reported.

Hello,
The integration airvisual is able to re-evaluate the interval between 2 requests (towards iqair) upon the initialisation of new location (key + city + area + country) ==> the trace `[homeassistant.components.airvisual] Leveling API key usage` is seen.
It means that the default value (5 minutes in source code) is updated.

On reboot on HA or when you remove a location, the  interval between 2 requests (towards iqair) is not updated.
In case of reboot of HA, the value is not correct since the number of iqair allowed per day is used too fast (I assume that the default value is used instead of correct one ==> 5 minutes instead of 27minutes in case of 5 monitored location)
